title: Ultra Onslaught

blocks.p: When fighting the Ultra Beasts or Necrozma, draw and play 1 Ultra Onslaught card at the start of each of their turns.
Discard any played cards. If the deck is out of cards, shuffle the discard pile back into the deck.

blocks.digital: In this game, when Ultra Onslaught is turned on, the game draws and discards the cards for you.
